python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
pages = [Path('docs/philosophy.md'), Path('docs/README.md'), *Path('docs/adrs').glob('000*.md')]
checked = 0
for page in pages:
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        if '://' in target:
            continue
        name, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        dest = (page.parent / name) if name else page
        assert dest.is_file(), (page, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            assert anchor in anchors, (page, target)
        checked += 1
print(f'Checked {checked} local links and anchors across {len(pages)} pages.')
